text:
ryan: Heads-up: release candidate blocked by a tiny regen diff from the codegen step. Looks like generated types order changed, changelog bot bumped minor and merge guard stopped publish
ci-bot: buildkite: #4922 failed during yarn regen -> git diff check :x:
tia: Minimal diff pasted: 
```diff
- export interface CreateSession { token: string; expiresAt?: string }
+ export interface CreateSession { expiresAt?: string; token: string }
```
gfx: Ugh the same nondeterministic property ordering. Our serializer doesn't stable-sort keys unless you pass --stable to typegen
karen: changelog-bot treats any file change as a candidate for bump. Because generated types changed it inferred a minor -> merge guard blocked the publish
merge-bot: merge-block: semver-guard triggered (suggested: minor)
ryan: Short fixes: 1) add generated globs to .semver-ignore 2) commit a stable regenerate (yarn typegen --stable) 3) ensure CI doesn't run interactive onboarding steps (set REDWOOD_ONBOARD=false in matrix)
tia: I ran `yarn typegen --stable` locally and got deterministic output. Committing regenerated files now
ci-bot: ryan pushed a commit, retriggering build :arrow_forward:
ci-bot: buildkite: #4922 rerun failed - sample-app e2e timed out due to onboarding script waiting for input :x:
gfx: On CI the onboarding script looks for REDWOOD_ONBOARD env; if unset it prompts. On our local runs it's set in my dev profile so we missed it
karen: I'll add REDWOOD_ONBOARD=false in the CI matrix and add src/generated/** to .semver-ignore. Also opening a PR to change the changelog bot to consult .semver-ignore before deciding bump type
doc-bot: PR opened: devex/docs#358 "Deterministic typegen and semver-ignore guidance"
merge-bot: rerun requested by karen :arrow_forward:
ci-bot: buildkite: #4922 rerun passed :white_check_mark: changelog-bot: no bump (docs-only)
ty: Thanks team. Follow-ups: make --stable the default in typegen, add a PR checklist item "run yarn typegen --stable", and add a lightweight pre-merge regen check in CI to catch this earlier
ryan: I'll file the RFC for typegen default soon. Closing once release merges. :rocket:
